description: This Java class 'EntitiesImportCtx' manages the context for importing entities in the Thingsboard platform, including tracking import results, entity relations, callbacks, and ID mappings.

classes.name: EntitiesImportCtx
classes.description: Manages the context and state during the import of entities, including tracking results, relations, callbacks, and ID mappings.

methods.name: EntitiesImportCtx
methods.description: Constructor initializing the import context with request ID, user, version ID, and optional settings.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the user.

methods.name: isFindExistingByName
methods.description: Checks if the import settings specify finding existing entities by name.

methods.name: isUpdateRelations
methods.description: Checks if relation updates are enabled in the import settings.

methods.name: isSaveAttributes
methods.description: Checks if attribute saving is enabled in the import settings.

methods.name: isSaveCredentials
methods.description: Checks if credential saving is enabled in the import settings.

methods.name: isSaveCalculatedFields
methods.description: Checks if calculated fields should be saved during import.

methods.name: getInternalId
methods.description: Retrieves the internal EntityId corresponding to an external EntityId from the cache.

methods.name: putInternalId
methods.description: Stores the mapping from an external EntityId to an internal EntityId.

methods.name: registerResult
methods.description: Records the creation or update result for a specific entity type.

methods.name: registerDeleted
methods.description: Records that an entity of a specific type has been deleted.

methods.name: addRelations
methods.description: Adds a collection of entity relations to the context.

methods.name: addReferenceCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked for a specific external entity ID.

methods.name: addEventCallback
methods.description: Adds an event callback to be executed later.

methods.name: registerNotFound
methods.description: Marks an external entity ID as not found.

methods.name: isNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an external entity ID has been marked as not found.
